message: the strawberry thing is a summer one-off, it ends 10 Aug
reply: Recorded Strawberry as ending on 2026-08-10 across all districts. Total orders across the 8 affected products decreased by 79 cases (from 248 to 169 cases), and the plan has been updated for review.

arguments.note: Set strawberry end date to 2026-08-10 as a summer one-off.

items.title: Water-based strawberry bars drove two-thirds of the strawberry surge across all districts, though daily gains moderated slightly in the second week—were there any unrecorded display changes or local campaigns, and should we plan for this uplift to continue into August?
items.note: Set strawberry end date to 2026-08-10 as a summer one-off.

items.title: In Kowloon, value-priced water-based bars surged 86% above forecast (while mid-price unit requests actually grew 8% despite a lower share)—did Kowloon stores see local events, footfall shifts, or competitor stockouts?

Existing open orders already push peak cold-store usage 4.4 pallets above our 68-pallet physical limit; can operations defer or stage incoming chocolate-coated deliveries to make room for additional water-based replenishment?

reply:
Reduced order quantities by 10% across all 25 value-price products. Total orders for this group decreased by 65 cases (from 657 to 592 cases).

Projected peak usage is now 69.8 pallets, driven entirely by inherited open orders exceeding our 68.0-pallet physical limit. The plan has been returned to Direction for review.

Adjusted orders to fit capacity at a 90% target, reducing orders across 9 products by a total of 80 cases (from 136 to 56 cases; edit ID 68). 

However, the 90% target (61.2 pallets) could not be met. Projected peak usage remains at 69.8 pallets because inherited open orders alone contribute 69.8 pallets (8.6 pallets above target and 1.8 pallets above our 68.0-pallet physical limit). Rescheduling incoming supplier deliveries or arranging overflow staging will be required to bring peak occupancy below capacity. The plan has been returned to Direction for review.
